actions.label: Configure three exact P12 legacy transitions

rollback.label: Unpause restored LevelManager after rollback verification

executionRules: Execute PREAPPROVAL actions before pausing; they do not change participant behavior.
Immediately before Pause, rescan production and abort if parent seeds or exceptions changed.
Execute MIGRATION actions strictly by index and verify each receipt before continuing.
No participant activation may be allowed between Pause and Unpause.
Do not execute Unpause unless every post-migration invariant passes.
